meta.conventions: amounts are exact decimal ZEN (18 decimals, trailing zeros dropped); times are UTC; a daily row is the state at the last block of that UTC day (at E on the last day); rewards_accrued_zen = unclaimed at the end of the day - unclaimed at the end of the previous day + claimed during the day; an empty cell / null means the column does not apply to the row type
meta.windDown: The stake and the unclaimed rewards at the chain's final block were paid out on Base by the wind-down distribution of 2026-11-20 (Base transaction 0x6a5373e35e8e328c667fd3ea6ac259cf0e41ba5c88fae52667ae37e1ec45219a), to the owner's own address unless it was held back or redirected. Those payments are Base transactions and are not rows of these files.
